notes: Gate 15 eval prompts for chalette:skill-creator Executor+Grader. Threshold >=90% pass rate. Capability-detection prompts assume a synthetic session WITHOUT the Vibe Prospecting tools unless the prompt name says _enriched (run those in a session WITH the tools connected).

prompts.name: company_web_only
assert: Produces a cited brief, not a raw link dump
Sources line says web only (no enrichment claimed when tools absent)
Closes with a confidence read tied to source coverage
Offers to save the brief as a confirm-choice, does not auto-save

prompts.name: company_known_entity_framing
prompts.input: what do we know about Northstar Partners
assert: Frames the subject against the workspace (resolves the existing entity first)
Brief leads with how the subject relates to the CEO's threads/people, not generic facts

prompts.name: person_background
assert: Treats as name-bearing: attempts entity resolve before searching
Does NOT fabricate biographical facts; flags low-confidence items

prompts.name: market_topic_no_entity
prompts.input: pull together research on AI pricing in logistics
assert: Runs topic research (no entity to resolve) without error
Cross-checks material claims across multiple sources with citations

prompts.name: company_enriched
prompts.input: research Acme Co before my call Thursday
assert: With Vibe Prospecting tools present: verifies firmographics against structured data
Surfaces trigger events (funding/hiring/leadership) web search would miss
Names decision-makers and flags the likely buyer
Surfaces estimated credit cost before any multi-entity pull
On save, routes decision-makers to people-crm (not loose notes)

prompts.name: negative_trigger_intake
assert: research does NOT fire — this routes to intel-intake (source already in hand)

prompts.name: negative_trigger_transcript
prompts.input: what did anyone say about pricing in my meetings
assert: research does NOT fire — this routes to transcript-search (own meetings, not the web)

prompts.name: negative_trigger_callprep
prompts.input: prep me for my meeting with Acme Co
assert: research does NOT fire on bare prep intent — that is call-prep
